title: Six Boxes
lines: The boxes have dishes and socks.
A fox hides in the last box.
Lin misses it and shuts the lid.
The box tips and the fox dashes off.
Lin fixes the box and packs it.
Then Lin checks all six boxes.

questions.listenFor: In the last box. It is stated right in the story - if your child cannot find it, have them go back and reread that line instead of telling them.

questions.ask: Why does Lin check all six boxes at the end?
questions.listenFor: Cause and effect: she does not want another surprise. Any answer that connects the checking back to the fox is doing the thinking you want.

questions.ask: Do you think Lin was cross with the fox? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason tied to the story - "no, she grins" or "yes, it made a mess of her packing."
